key_claims: Al-Qaeda uses Israel rhetorically; its 2021 Gaza statements are coordinated across AQSL, AQIM, JNIM, AQAP and Hurras al-Din, suggesting media cohesion.
AQIM's statement prioritizes fighting 'secular traitor' regimes (Abbas, normalizing Arab states) even over fighting Israel, a near-enemy emphasis.
Zawahiri's son-in-law Abd al-Rahman al-Maghrebi still runs al-Qaeda's as-Sahab media arm, showing continuity at senior levels.
LWJ estimates the Taliban controls 87 and contests 214 of Afghanistan's 407 districts (74%), roughly double January 2018; 16 provincial capitals are under direct threat.
US and NATO forces prevented the Taliban from holding provincial capitals; with the withdrawal, the hosts expect the return of the Islamic Emirate and resurgence of al-Qaeda.
The Taliban has not complied with the Doha deal; Biden officials' claim that the deal tied their hands is rejected by the hosts.
Taliban statements by Akhundzada and Sirajuddin Haqqani are peppered with Islamic Emirate references and call democracy un-Islamic and the Afghan government apostates.
